description.html: Sera Reptil Professional Carnivor Nature is a complete staple food for carnivorous reptiles, above all aquatic turtles. The granules are two-colored and float: the outer ring contains aquatic organisms as a source of protein and omega fatty acids, while the core is produced at a lower temperature to preserve nutrients. It belongs to the Sera Nature range, with no artificial dyes or preservatives.

Ingredients include fish meal, gammarus (4%), krill, green-lipped mussel, fish oil, sea algae, brewer's yeast and garlic, with added vitamins A, D3, E, B1, B2 and C. The manufacturer highlights a calcium-to-phosphorus ratio that supports bone and shell growth.

Feed sparingly, as much as the turtle eats in a few minutes, and remove leftovers from the water so they do not burden the filter. Depending on the animal's needs, the granules can be combined with fresh food. Learn more about the setup in our turtle aquarium guide.

Order by phone or WhatsApp message. Fast courier delivery. Customers in Novi Sad can pick up their order directly at our workshop. Contact us with any questions about the product or for a recommendation for your species.
